cases.steps: Issue Apple test pass; add through web, then native entry; cancel once
cases.expected: Genuine signed pass rendered in Wallet; cancellation never says saved; returning to Taplo does not infer install from a click

cases.steps: Issue Google demo/test object; save through web/native eligible account
cases.expected: Intended class/object attached to correct account; test status recorded; no public publishing assertion

cases.steps: Reopen add link on same device and on second authorised device
cases.expected: Same intended relationship/pass identity; no duplicated loyalty account or balance

cases.steps: Scan Customer A on each of the four phone pairings
cases.expected: Server resolves correct business/programme; staff sees permitted safe context; no ledger mutation on decode

cases.steps: Select completed appointment A and confirm earn
cases.expected: Exactly one earn and one eligibility transition; reference to source appointment; UI receipt and authoritative progress eight

cases.steps: Repeat scan/confirmation on two staff phones concurrently
cases.expected: Same source cannot earn twice; second attempt retrieves existing result or conflict; one authoritative ledger effect

cases.steps: Redeem Customer B on two devices concurrently
cases.expected: At most one success; second shows current outcome; no negative reward balance or second entitlement

cases.steps: Disconnect before request, after server commit and before response separately
cases.expected: No false offline success; unknown outcome reconciles by original operation key; no blind replacement debit/earn

cases.steps: Scan wrong merchant, public professional card, foreign URL, malformed, expired or revoked code
cases.expected: No mutation; clear safe explanation; no arbitrary URL launch/script execution; no unauthorised tenant switch

cases.steps: Scan as staff without grant; remove authorised staff before confirmation
cases.expected: Server denies consequential action under current membership; cached UI cannot authorise it; no leaked private customer details

cases.steps: Copy loyalty QR screenshot; try high-value redemption and account access
cases.expected: Static reference is not account login or sufficient holder proof; required policy/challenge enforced; no automatic success

cases.steps: Record cash visit through supported manual workflow; earn; reverse eligible transaction
cases.expected: Correct manual/cash provenance and authority; source-linked earn/reversal; never labelled Stripe-confirmed

cases.steps: Update ledger and queue Apple/Google pass update; hold phone offline then reconnect
cases.expected: Ledger changes once; queued/delayed/failed status truthfully visible; provider cache is not money authority; eventual rendering observed and timed

cases.steps: Remove pass, add again; rotate signing material with approved procedure
cases.expected: Update registrations/objects handled without leaking access; documented recovery and continuity; no simulated certificate-expiry claim

cases.steps: Add Sam public card; scan with ordinary phone camera
cases.expected: Correct published mini-space/staff booking context opens without compulsory Taplo install; public code cannot redeem rewards

cases.steps: Unpublish Sam profile/remove staff while old pass remains on another offline phone
cases.expected: When public destination is requested it enforces current publication; no unrelated new-employer redirect or false promise remote card image is erased

cases.steps: Deny camera, revoke permission in OS, background scanner, scan under glare/low light
cases.expected: Accessible permission recovery/manual-code option; request only at task; no duplicate action on resume; no frame uploads unless separately justified

cases.steps: Change plan, pause programme, close merchant, refund already-earned qualifying work
cases.expected: Earned obligations retained under specified policy; new entitlement gates and financial/reward ledgers stay separate; no blanket points deletion

cases.steps: Inspect pass/back fields, scanner, logs, public link, push payload and screenshots
cases.expected: No email/private notes/balance secrets in public card; secrets/opaque tokens redacted from telemetry; scanner data minimised

cases.steps: Open customer/Studio widgets logged out, expired, removed staff and stale snapshot
cases.expected: Private fields redacted by default; no live-availability claim; deep link reauthorises; widget never directly refunds/redeems

cases.steps: Upgrade backend with older supported native build installed
cases.expected: Version compatibility or explicit safe upgrade gate; accepted work still has browser/support recovery route

cases.steps: Exercise VoiceOver/TalkBack, large text and malformed input; verify copy and screen bounds
cases.expected: Correct reading/focus/error order, usable close/back/confirmation, QR readable with quiet zone; no clipped essential total/action
